assets.title: Submerged Sediment Shoal
assets.description: Original S02 local riverbed-rise shoal over a 2 m straight run. A real asymmetric faceted sediment lens raises the bed from Z=.09 to .135 m under one connected flat water surface at Z=.16 m, leaving at least .025 m water depth. The separate closed water body has a bed-conforming bottom in actual opposed contact with the raised terrain; this is not a dry bank, flat shallow-stream recolour or exposed sediment island. Both ends match the actual existing width-transition narrow terrain cap union: bank feet Y=+/- .30, raw water edges Y=+/- .36, end planes X=-1/+1 m. Old west placement Rz=180 degrees plus (-2,0,0) m; east placement +(2,0,0) m. Water bottom cap edges retreat .01 m, retaining the old paired .02 m bottom V gap. Only surface continuity is claimed; terrain finite-area cap contact and water top-edge/tangent compatibility are verified separately. Visible end-adjacent earth/water PBR stays legacy-identical. Hidden single terrain caps do not reproduce the old separated bed/bank cap material partition. Only interior ShoalWater uses alpha BLEND opacity .28, base RGB (.70,.82,.78), zero transmission, roughness0 and glTF-default IOR1.5 as a non-refracting stylized static material, not real water optics. Other materials stay opaque. Transparent face sorting remains renderer-dependent and is bounded by the supplied runtime checks; sediment is real editable topology underneath. One continuous closed terrain mesh and one separate closed water mesh, no decorative stones or props. No exact bend, whole-scene or cliff-side snap. Static visual only; no animated flow, hydrology, fluid volume continuity, collision, navigation, wading safety or physics certification.
